evocation.name: Evocation
evocation.desc: Raw force, fire, frost and lightning, thrown hard.

abjuration.name: Abjuration
abjuration.desc: Wards, shields and undoing other people's magic.

conjuration.name: Conjuration
conjuration.desc: Calling things from elsewhere: creatures, acid, mist and doors.

divination.name: Divination
divination.desc: Seeing what is hidden, far away or yet to come. Identifies magic items.

enchantment.name: Enchantment
enchantment.desc: Bending minds: charm, fear, sleep and command.

illusion.name: Illusion
illusion.desc: Light and sound that lie: veils, phantoms and blinding glare.

necromancy.name: Necromancy
necromancy.desc: Life force taken and spent: drains, rot and the restless dead.

transmutation.name: Transmutation
transmutation.desc: Changing what things are: stone to mud, flesh to iron, slow to fast.

lantern.name: The Lantern
lantern.desc: Healing, light and the hearth. The most common faith in the north.

harvest.name: The Harvest
harvest.desc: Growth, roots, weather and the turning year. Farmers' prayers.

iron_oath.name: The Iron Oath
iron_oath.desc: Courage, protection and holy war. Soldiers' and guards' prayers.

grave.name: The Grave
grave.desc: Death, rest and turning back the dead who won't stay down.

storm.name: The Storm
storm.desc: Wind, thunder and the sea. Sailors' and travellers' prayers.

veil.name: The Veil
veil.desc: Secrets, luck and trickery. Smugglers' and gamblers' prayers.

ballistics.name: Ballistics
ballistics.desc: Firearms and ammunition: building them, and shooting tricks with them.

steamworks.name: Steamworks
steamworks.desc: Boilers and pistons: steam weapons, engines and armour.

optics.name: Optics
optics.desc: Scopes, lenses, flash lamps and assay instruments.

automata.name: Automata
automata.desc: Clockwork helpers, turrets and the care of Wrought.

blade.name: Blade
blade.desc: Sword and knife technique: feints, ripostes and bleeding cuts.

heavy_arms.name: Heavy Arms
heavy_arms.desc: Hammers, axes and polearms: knockdowns and cleaving blows.

archery.name: Archery
archery.desc: Aimed shots, volleys and pinning arrows.

skirmish.name: Skirmish
skirmish.desc: Footwork and staying where the blow isn't.

shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.desc: Ambush, poison and the knife in the back.

command.name: Command
command.desc: Rallying, ordering and steadying a party.

fieldcraft.name: Fieldcraft
fieldcraft.desc: Field medicine, snares and living off the land.

smithing.name: Smithing
smithing.desc: Craft tree. Schematics for blades, armour and tools (owned by the crafting system).

herbalism.name: Herbalism
herbalism.desc: Craft tree. Recipes for remedies and poisons (owned by the crafting system).

enchanting.name: Enchanting
enchanting.desc: Craft tree. Formulae for binding magic into items (owned by the crafting system).

consecration.name: Consecration
consecration.desc: Craft tree. Blessings, holy water and relics (owned by the crafting system).
